newsitem.title: USA: Computer hacker breaks into JonBenet murder files.
newsitem.headline: Computer hacker breaks into JonBenet murder files.

text.p: In another bizarre twist in the investigation of who killed 6-year-old beauty pageant winner JonBenet Ramsey, authorities said someone gained access to the "war room" where officials keep sensitive information about the case on a computer.

Police believe the incident happened early Saturday. Only a few people including four detectives and a few investigators from the district attorney's office have access to the room at the Boulder County Justice Centre.
The Colorado Bureau of Investigation was expected to investigate the possible theft of computer files from the nearly six-month old probe.

The child's father John Ramsey discovered her body the day after Christmas in the basement of their home in Boulder after her mother said she found a ransom note demanding $118,000. No arrests have been made and no suspects have been named.
The family is spending the summer in northern Michigan and press reports say they may return to Georgia, where they lived before coming to Boulder in the early 1990s.
